children.value: > Fact From Story: Shortly after Flexport reached out with the offer, Clark took the stage at the same supply chain conference in Phoenix that Petersen spoke at earlier in the day.
> > Fact From Story: Flexport offered Clark a block of 2 million shares if he signed a separation agreement that included nondisclosure and nondisparagement clauses.
> > > Fact From Story: Clark has largely remained silent since he was forced to resign on Sept. 5.
> > > Fact From Story: Clark declined the offer.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: People who decline a deal that includes remaining silent are more likely to speak out.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Refusing to sign a nondisclosure agreement suggests a willingness to speak openly.
> Commonsense Knowledge: People who sign nondisclosure agreements are not likely to publicly criticize their former employers.
